founder.name: Abhishek Bhowmick
founder.title: Founder & Principal Growth Architect
bio_paragraphs: 21 years of experience with top global brands across India, Middle East and Europe. Started as a copywriter, moved to 360-degree campaign planning, and led gold-standard teams at India's biggest loyalty management company.
Now as Founder and Fractional Marketer at Ekalavya Consulting, I help ambitious brands fix their go-to-market and drive high-velocity growth.
founder.quote: I observe in silence, plan in 360°, and strike with one arrow.

council.title: The Fractional CMO Council
council.description: Senior growth architects with 15+ years steering commercial P&L, brand positioning, and market penetration across tech, enterprise, and high-growth consumer categories.

strike_team.title: Surgical Execution Strike Team
